text:
carmen (AE): Quick one — Prospect (Polaris Labs) returned the MSA with DPA asking for KMS attestation, Net60 on the PO, and they block DocuSign. Need a fast path to sign so Dedicated POC stays on track.

anu (Legal): Paste the DPA line if you have it. Short: we can add a 1-page KMS addendum promising a tenant-scoped attestation within 7 business days. For signatures, portal-upload + audit trail is acceptable. Wet-ink only if >$200k.

carmen (AE): Redline: "Vendor shall provide KMS attestation and allow customer access to key usage metadata prior to production."

anu (Legal): Counter: "Vendor will provide a signed KMS/HSM attestation limited to cryptographic material used by Customer within 7 business days of request. Audit access limited to tenant-scoped usage summaries; Vendor will not disclose private key material." I'll draft now.

mike (Finance): Net60 is higher risk. If PO < $25k we do Net30. If they insist on Net60 require CFO signoff and either $20k refundable hold or milestone billing (50% upfront). Also invoice must include PO number and remit info.

devon (Infra): Attestation ops: we can deliver HSM-signed attestations in ~3 business days if scope is narrow. DocuSign blocked -> options: (1) they whitelist our signing IP 3.24.18.0/24 temporarily, (2) they upload signed PDF to our secure portal (audit hash stored), (3) client-side hosted signing (no outbound egress). Portal upload is fastest.

portal-bot: Uploaded redline: https://secure.docs/redwood/polaris/msa_dpa_redline.pdf  checklist: [KMS addendum draft] [Finance Net terms decision] [Signature fallback confirmed] [SOC2 link sent]

carmen (AE): Actions: I'll ask procurement whether Net60 is mandatory and whether they can whitelist signing IP or accept portal upload. Anu: please drop the addendum link when ready. Mike: PO estimate ~18k.

anu (Legal): Will draft the addendum today with the 7 business day attestation and portal-upload signature clause.

mike (Finance): PO 18k => Net30 ok. If they push Net60 escalate to me.

carmen (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
